data.title: bn-1ca: audited SQLite coordination store
data.description: Review the initial migration, per-connection durability settings, transaction and audit atomicity, schema whitelist, and coverage of independent revision changes.

data.body: [HIGH] A lost acknowledgement makes an identical publication finish fail. The first link commits the index, checkpoint and completed intent. Repeating it reaches this INSERT before consulting the completed intent and hits a UNIQUE constraint. I confirmed this by applying the migration and running the exact SQL with the same index twice. The frozen cross-lane ADR §4 (publication contract, line 73) requires an identical finish to return the original receipt even after a subsequent head advance. Within the transaction, recognize the completed matching intent and index, return a stable success without another audit or revision, and keep conflicting metadata an error. Cover retry on a fresh connection after another publication.

[HIGH] A stale step write erases durable dispatch receipts. After recording an instrument reference, observed effects and a nonempty flow list, replaying the original intent for the same run, number, step, digest and floor succeeds and changes those three stored values to NULL, NULL and []. I confirmed that sequence against the exact upsert. record_run also calls this helper, so a previous run snapshot can cause the same loss. This discards the run-bound evidence needed for recovery under plan §7.5. Allow pending steps to acquire a receipt, preserve previously recorded evidence on stale replay, and reject incompatible receipt replacements atomically. Cover both public write paths and check the audit and revision on rejection.

[HIGH] record_run accepts an older snapshot even after the run finalized. Replaying the original declaration with the same IDs, key and experiment changes (finalized, reconciliation_required, unknown effects, failed cleanup) to (declared, no flags, no effects, cleanup not_required). I confirmed this with the exact runs upsert. This can clear the durable conditions that block closure under INV-19. Guard updates against stale state, for example by checking the observed run version or using explicit transitions. Add a two-connection regression in which the stale writer is rejected and the newer state and audit revision survive.

data.reason: An identical publication retry fails after commit. Stale run and step writes can erase finalized recovery state and durable dispatch receipts. See th-1plvku, th-20z8md and th-3r5kjq.

data.body: Fixed at 090689c. A completed intent checks every index field under the write lock and returns its historical audit revision. The fresh-connection regression advances the head first, then verifies the exact receipt and rejects changed artifact metadata with no new revision.

Fixed at 090689c. A step can acquire references, effects and flows. Removing or replacing acquired fields rejects the transaction. Tests cover pending replay and each conflicting field through record_step and record_run, including rollback of the enclosing run update, audit and revision.

Fixed at 090689c. record_run requires the prior run-metadata commit revision for updates and accepts None only on creation. The two-connection regression checks rejected stale writes preserve finalized state, flags, effects, cleanup, audit count and revision. An update based on the current receipt succeeds.

[HIGH] The receipt guard makes unresolved dispatch irreversible. A stored Some(Effect::Unknown) is a recorded unresolved dispatch (domain.rs:152). If subsequent evidence for the same instrument reference establishes a send or a pre-dispatch refusal, both Unknown -> Observed and Unknown -> None now return Conflict. I exercised the exact upsert for both outcomes while preserving all other fields; each changed zero rows and the stored effect remained unknown. Plan §7.5 explicitly requires these resolutions. Allow refinement of unknown while protecting established outcomes from erasure or contradictory replacements. Exercise both resolution branches, both store entry points and atomic audit/revision behavior.

data.body: Fixed at fbb65c8. Unknown effects can settle to observed or none for the matching step receipt. The new regression failed against 090689c and passes through both record_step and record_run for both outcomes. It checks changed references, outcome erasure, reversal and contradiction all reject atomically, while each accepted refinement produces exactly one audit event and revision.

data.reason: Verified fbb65c8 through record_run and record_step. Both unresolved-to-established transitions commit and audit once with compatible receipts. Erasure, contradictory outcomes, and substitutions fail atomically. All 12 focused tests and an independent 96-case SQL matrix passed.
